comp.chatParticipant.description: Intelligently compresses API specs and large code before sending your question to the LLM.
comp.conversationRecording.enabled.descr:
**(Beta)** Automatically record each conversation turn with AI agents to `.comp/history/`, so `session_recall` can restore it in later sessions. Off by default.

When on, **comP: Setup Agents** installs a Stop hook (`comp-daemon record-turn`) into `.claude/settings.local.json` for Claude Code. Records stay inside this workspace and are never sent anywhere.

Turning this off stops recording immediately but keeps the installed hook; run **comP: Remove Conversation Recording Hooks** (`comp.removeHistoryHooks`) to remove it.
comp.conversationRecording.claudeCode.de: **(Beta)** Record Claude Code conversations (Stop hook). Takes effect only while `comp.conversationRecording.enabled` is on.
comp.removeHistoryHooks.title: Remove Conversation Recording Hooks (Beta)
